forum.title: SPI2 not generated on STM32L051C8Tx
forum.best_answer_content:
Yellow pins mean the peripheral isn’t enabled.

In the SPI2 peripheral, enable it by choosing a mode such as two-way master.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/15820ce2-f842-4551-bf23-1c32ac35d572.png)
